services.name: Fishing charter
services.desc: Everything needed for fishing is covered including licenses, rods, reels, tackle, bait, and ice. The Captain will filet, ice and bag your catch for you! Several nearby seafood restaurants will cook your catch for you anyway you like for the ultimate Hook and Cook experience! On a backcounty sport fishing trip we are typically in 1-5 ft of water on shallow grass flats. We quietly troll into the mangroves where we target Snook, Redfish, Spotted Sea Trout, Black Drum, Flounder, Mackerel and Tarpon. On the Tampa Bay inshore reef trip we fish in 20-50ft of water dropping down on Tampa Bays reefs and in the deep water shipping channel. Here we target Red Grouper, Gag Grouper, Mangrove Snapper,

blurb: Guests fish in Tampa Bay and nearby Gulf waters targeting species such as Snook, Redfish, Black Drum, Flounder, Spotted Sea Trout, Tripletails, Kingfish, Tarpon, Snapper, Grouper, and Sharks. Charters include night fishing, backcountry sport fishing, inshore reef fishing, nearshore offshore fishing, and shark fishing. Trips are family friendly and suitable for all skill levels and ages.
extraNote: Charters depart just minutes from St Petersburg, St Pete Beach and Treasure Island
